title: Tashkent Rising Again
author: Lior Nakamura
blurb: Dominic Lockridge, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
